snippet.title: Deep Rock Galactic: Season 05 - Cosmetic DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
When you bear the armor of the Order of the Deep, you represent this mighty guild as generations of graybeards have done before you. Let your pickaxe pierce with the Order's might, and claim the depths -- for Rock and Stone.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2934390/Deep_Rock_Galactic__Order_of_the_Deep_Pack/

--------------------
DEEP ROCK GALACTIC is a co-op-first sci-fi FPS featuring badass space Dwarves, 100% destructible environments, procedurally-generated caves, and endless hordes of alien monsters.

--------------------
Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/548430
Microsoft Store: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productId/9NHFVWX1V7QJ
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/233449/
--------------------
Find out more:
http://www.deeprockgalactic.com/
